history.text: The WWWF's main tag title role passed to this new title after the International title was limited to the Pittsburgh market.
The Strongbows' win was reversed after Mr. Fuji was pinned with a foot on the ropes, so their reign was voided.
WWF bought selected WCW assets, and the WCW tag title was added to WWF programming.
Titles were temporarily unified at SummerSlam in a steel cage match, with both titles remaining active.
At Survivor Series, the WCW title was deactivated and the WWF title continued, with The Dudley Boyz as the final WCW champions.
The title was assigned to SmackDown during the initial WWE brand extension draft.
The Un-Americans took the title to Raw, and SmackDown received a new title with the same name.
The title moved to ECW after John Morrison and The Miz won it, though teams from Raw and ECW could challenge for it.
The Colóns unified the two titles at WrestleMania 25 as the Unified WWE Tag Team Championship, with both remaining active.
The World Tag Team Championship was decommissioned, and the WWE Tag Team Championship continued its lineage without the "unified" name.
